CBULK.stands_in_for: every bulk and decoupling capacitance on the coil supply and the logic rail as one ideal capacitor, with no ESR, no ESL and no DC bias derating

RCOILS.stands_in_for: all four coils as one resistance at the low end of their tolerance, which draws more than four real coils would

RLOGIC.stands_in_for: the series element between the coil supply and the logic rail, at its nominal value

RMCU.stands_in_for: the MCU's draw as a fixed resistance at the datasheet's own maximum current into VCC, which is far above its stated typical consumption

RPATH.stands_in_for: the field wiring, the source and the reverse-polarity device as one series resistance; the wiring part is a budget this board states rather than measures

SRC.stands_in_for: the external supply held at the low end of the board's declared input range, as an ideal source with no output impedance of its own

SWITCH.stands_in_for: the instant firmware energises every channel at once, as an ideal switch with no on-resistance
